title: Unraveling the carcinogenic mechanisms of benzo[a]pyrene in prostate cancer: a multi-omics approach.
authors: Xiao, Jiansheng; Zheng, Handa; Wu, Guohao; Li, Ping; Zhong, Qiyu; Lv, Qiao; Chen, Jiahui; Lai, Caiyong; Ye, Dongming
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过多组学方法探究苯并[a]芘在前列腺癌中的致癌机制，虽含分子对接但核心是毒理网络与转录组分析，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与课题关联微弱。
abstract: Although cigarette smoke is a recognized risk factor for prostate cancer (PCa), the specific contribution of benzo[a]pyrene (BaP), one of its major carcinogenic constituents, remains poorly understood. To elucidate the pathogenic mechanisms of BaP in PCa, this study integrated diverse methodologies, including network toxicology, single-cell transcriptomics, differential gene expression analysis, molecular docking, Mendelian randomization (MR), and bibliometrics. Two hundred thirty-two overlapping genes were identified between BaP targets and PCa-related genes. Hub genes TP53, EGFR, SRC, HSP90AA1, and INS were enriched in MAPK and PI3K-Akt pathways. Molecular docking confirmed strong BaP binding to these proteins. Single-cell transcriptomics revealed cell-type-specific expression patterns, while ROC (TP53 AUC = 0.67) and MR analyses (TP53 p = 2.66 x 10(-)(6)) supported their diagnostic and causal relevance. TP53 showed notable expression variability linked to Gleason scores. Bibliometric analysis highlighted TP53's evolving research significance in PCa, particularly in resistance and personalized therapy. BaP may drive PCa progression by disrupting oncogenic pathways via core targets, notably TP53, EGFR, and HSP90AA1. TP53 may act as a protective factor associated with tumor aggressiveness. These findings offer mechanistic insights into BaP-related PCa etiology and suggest potential biomarkers for diagnosis and therapy.
abstract_zh: 尽管香烟烟雾是前列腺癌（PCa）的公认风险因素，但其主要致癌成分之一苯并[a]芘（BaP）的具体贡献仍知之甚少。为阐明BaP在PCa中的致病机制，本研究整合了多种方法，包括网络毒理学、单细胞转录组学、差异基因表达分析、分子对接、孟德尔随机化（MR）和文献计量学。在BaP靶点与PCa相关基因之间鉴定出232个重叠基因。核心基因TP53、EGFR、SRC、HSP90AA1和INS富集于MAPK和PI3K-Akt通路。分子对接证实BaP与这些蛋白质具有强结合能力。单细胞转录组学揭示了细胞类型特异性表达模式，而ROC（TP53 AUC = 0.67）和MR分析（TP53 p = 2.66 x 10(-)(6)）支持其诊断和因果相关性。TP53显示出与Gleason评分相关的显著表达变异性。文献计量学分析强调了TP53在PCa中不断演变的研究重要性，特别是在耐药性和个性化治疗方面。BaP可能通过核心靶点（尤其是TP53、EGFR和HSP90AA1）破坏致癌通路，从而驱动PCa进展。TP53可能作为与肿瘤侵袭性相关的保护因素。这些发现为BaP相关PCa病因学提供了机制性见解，并提示了潜在的诊断和治疗生物标志物。
